report.title: Capture the verbatim user prompt.
values: The user request, reproduced verbatim: ${verbatimUserPrompt}

report.title: Determine the user intent.
values: The user implicit and explicit intent in this conversation: ${userIntent}

report.title: Decide if the user intent triggers minimal mode.
values: The user intent being evaluated: ${userIntent}
Whether the user intent triggers minimal mode: ${exampleMatch}

report.title: Resolve Minimal Mode Switch, if True enter Minimal Mode, Else Proceed.
values: The minimal mode switch value: ${exampleMatch}
The user intent to fulfill in minimal mode: ${userIntent}
The requested answer, output, or deliverable produced in minimal mode: ${minimalResult}

report.title: Decide which files must be mutated or created for the user intent.
values: The user intent requiring file mutation or creation: ${userIntent}
The files to mutate or create: ${targetFiles}

report.title: Generate requirements by mapping user intent to data changes.
values: The files in which changes are required: ${targetFiles}
The user intent requiring each change: ${userIntent}
The required changes, including their locations, descriptions, intent, and operators: ${requirements}

report.title: Restate the user intent for example matching.
values: The user intent, restated for example matching: ${userIntent}

report.title: Match the user intent to the closest example without changing its meaning.
values: The intent being compared with the nine examples: ${userIntent}
The example selected for its matching intent: ${matchedExample}

report.title: Determine the execution mode by looking up the matched example number.
values: The selected example whose number is used in the lookup: ${matchedExample}
The execution mode obtained from that lookup: ${mode}

report.title: Input the selected execution mode.
values: The execution mode supplied to the following procedures: ${mode}

report.title: If the mode is fidelity, execute the requirements and return the changes; otherwise, skip.
values: The mode determining whether fidelity runs: ${mode}
The changes to execute in fidelity mode: ${requirements}
The actual changes made in fidelity mode: ${changeList}

report.title: If the mode is accountability, execute and assess the requirements, correct unfinished or unapproved changes, and repeat until zero outstanding requirements.
values: The mode determining whether accountability runs: ${mode}
The requirements completed in accountability mode, accumulated across iterations: ${requirementsCompleted}
The required changes to execute in accountability mode: ${requirements}
The actual changes made during the current accountability iteration: ${changeList}
How actual changes correspond to requirements, including missed requirements and unapproved changes: ${changeAssessment}

The completed requirements added to the accumulated list: ${requirementsCompleted}
The changes required to undo unapproved changes and restore the affected data: ${rescissionRequirements}
The remaining, missed, and corrective changes required for the next accountability iteration: ${requirements}
The completed requirements returned when accountability execution finishes: ${requirementsCompleted}
